project_identity.name: Crixaa
project_identity.tagline: The underwriting decisioning layer for new-to-credit MSME loans in India
project_identity.archetype: The Performance Pro & Swiss Engineering Infrastructure (Stripe / Modern Treasury / Ramp register)
project_identity.target_audience: NBFC and Small Finance Bank Head of Credit, Head of Underwriting, Model Risk & Compliance Officers
project_identity.theme_mode: Light mode (calm, institutional neutral background with sharp high-contrast slate ink and single vivid emerald-teal CTA accent)
project_identity.regulatory_stance: Compliant with RBI 2022 Digital Lending Guidelines (Non-delegation of underwriting) and June 2026 Draft Model Risk Management Framework

rules: Strictly single primary CTA accent color (#047857 / Deep Emerald) reserved exclusively for conversion buttons and key interactive nodes.
Every stat number uses tabular numerals (font-mono or font-sans tabular-nums) for precision.
Inline attribution captions must be muted slate (#64748B) with underline on hover to linked sources.
Header background MUST use backdrop-blur glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md) with border-b border-slate-200/80 - never fully transparent.

body.font_family: Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans, sans-serif

code_and_numbers.usage: All stat callouts, financial figures (₹, lakhs, crores, percentages), specimen tags, and reason codes.

rules: BANNED for Headings: Inter, generic AI system sans, or space grotesk.
Heading hierarchy step rule: maximum jump of 2 tailwind scale steps between heading and subheading.
Overlines/labels: UPPERCASE text-xs tracking-[0.2em] font-mono text-emerald-800 bg-emerald-50 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full inline-block border border-emerald-200/60.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: The Swiss Engineering Grid & Bento Protocol
rules: Generous spacing strategy: containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
Never center everything. Left-aligned editorial hierarchy for titles, paragraphs, and list items.
Grid children must be direct children. Animation wrappers (framer-motion) must carry layout classes.
Responsive layout: Mobile-first (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 or custom bento spans).

motion_and_craft.smooth_scrolling: Lenis smooth scroll integration on window.

framer_motion_patterns.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line opacity and Y-translation reveal with staggered entrance (delay Children 0.1s).
framer_motion_patterns.scroll_section_entrance: fade-in-up (initial: { opacity: 0, y: 24 }, animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 }, viewport: { once: true, margin: '-80px' }).
framer_motion_patterns.hover_micro_interactions: border highlight transition, subtle scale (1.01), subtle translation (-2px Y), shadow-md glow on CTA.

motion_and_craft.marquee: Slow editorial drift marquee using react-fast-marquee or custom framer loop with pale slate background and dark slate text for RBI compliance principles / data rails.
motion_and_craft.interactive_specimen: Interactive Crixaa decision specimen card in hero with toggleable tabs (Overview, Cash Flow Data, GST Signals, Audit Trail & Override) so buyers can inspect live explainability features.

narrative_sections_spec.title: The Personal-vs-Business Paradox
narrative_sections_spec.stat_label: Credit growth multiplier to individual entrepreneurs vs their business entities (Mar 2023 – Mar 2026)
narrative_sections_spec.narrative: A founder can carry a personal credit score above 750, pay every EMI on time for years, and still watch their own business get declined the moment a lender is asked to score the entity instead of the person. Lenders already trust the person. They still can't see the business behind them — even when it's the exact same person they'd already approve.

narrative_sections_spec.title: Zoom Out to the Whole Population
narrative_sections_spec.quote: Gig workers, first-time entrepreneurs, and informal-sector business owners are largely creditworthy. Lenders simply can't see it — because their financial behaviour was never captured by a traditional credit bureau.
narrative_sections_spec.quote_author: SIDBI (Small Industries Development Bank of India)

narrative_sections_spec.title: What It Costs Lenders Today Without This

lender_cards.name: SBFC Finance
lender_cards.context: Listed NBFC (₹5L–30L loans) approves under 40% of applications, choosing to forego growth rather than absorb unquantified credit risk — 89% of its book is concentrated in borrowers with CIBIL > 700.

lender_cards.name: Aye Finance
lender_cards.context: Gross NPA climbed from 4.21% to ~4.85% between FY25 and H1 FY26, with profits dropping ~40% YoY driven by rising impairment costs in new-to-credit segments.

lender_cards.name: Five-Star Business Finance
lender_cards.context: Operates inside Crixaa's ₹1L–10L target band but solves borrower uncertainty by requiring hard collateral on 99% of its loan book, shutting out asset-light micro-businesses.
lender_cards.attribution: Five-Star Business Finance, CARE Ratings, June 2025

lender_cards.name: NeoGrowth Credit
lender_cards.context: Carries 96% unsecured exposure to MSME borrowers rated as having a 'moderate credit profile', leaving earnings vulnerable to unexpected macro shocks.

narrative_sections_spec.framing_line: Real lenders in this exact segment are already choosing between two bad options: decline the volume, or absorb the risk. Neither is a permanent answer.

steps.name: Connect
steps.description: Plugs into Account Aggregator, GSTN, and bureau data the lender already pulls — zero new manual document uploads for the borrower.

steps.name: Score
steps.description: Generates a cohort-calibrated recommendation with a explicit confidence interval, never a black-box numerical score.

steps.name: Explain
steps.description: Attaches human-readable reason codes tailored for your Model Risk Committee and RBI compliance auditors.

steps.name: Decide
steps.description: Your underwriter reviews, makes the final determination, or overrides — with decision and rationale automatically logged.

steps.name: Learn
steps.description: Real repayment outcomes automatically recalibrate the next decision recommendation for that specific sub-cohort.

narrative_sections_spec.title: Built Inside the Rules, Not Around Them

regulatory_pillars.title: RBI Digital Lending Guidelines (2022)
regulatory_pillars.detail: Prohibits regulated lenders from outsourcing core underwriting judgment. Crixaa recommends; your underwriter always decides.

regulatory_pillars.title: Draft Model Risk Management Framework (June 2026)
regulatory_pillars.detail: Requires formal Board-approved governance and explainability for AI/ML models across NBFCs. Crixaa is architected for this exact standard.

regulatory_pillars.title: Account Aggregator & GSTN Infrastructure
regulatory_pillars.detail: Native integration with RBI-regulated AA consent flows and official GSTN tax compliance data — no parallel pipelines or scraped data.

narrative_sections_spec.title: How We Work: A Structured Pilot
narrative_sections_spec.subhead: A structured pilot, not a leap of faith.
narrative_sections_spec.pilot_flow: Connect one real portfolio's new-to-credit segment → Crixaa scores every application in shadow for 90 days alongside your existing process (no live decisions changed) → compare recommendations against actual repayment outcomes → your credit committee decides whether to go live using your own portfolio data.

narrative_sections_spec.title: Why Crixaa
differentiators: Built for borrowers with no bureau file, not repurposed from existing credit scoring
Every recommendation ships with plain-language reason codes your Model Risk Committee can audit
Recommends, never auto-approves — your underwriter maintains 100% final authority
Works with data you already collect (Account Aggregator, GST, bureau pull where present)
Calibrated against real new-to-credit cohort outcomes, not synthetic assumptions
Built natively for RBI's 2026 Model Risk Management governance standards

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Do NOT build a pitch deck or consumer app look. Build an engineering-grade B2B fintech infrastructure site matching Stripe / Modern Treasury.
2. Strict single primary CTA wording: 'Start a conversation' (repeated top nav and bottom CTA section only).

3. No fabricated customer logos, fake 'trusted by 500+ banks' badges, or fake investor lists. Credibility comes entirely from real third-party data attributions (SIDBI, TransUnion CIBIL, SBFC, Aye, Five-Star, NeoGrowth, RBI).
4. Ensure all stat numbers use tabular numerals (tabular-nums font-mono or font-sans) and include muted inline attribution captions hyperlinked to actual source text.
5. Use Framer Motion for scroll reveals and Lenis for smooth scrolling.
6. Build the contact form modal and inline form so it saves submissions to localStorage/state and displays a clear Sonner toast notification.
7. Include all 12 narrative sections in exact sequence as specified.
8. Ensure every key component and button has a data-testid attribute.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI slop: use distinctive light theme with slate/emerald palette, sharp borders, layered shadows, subtle grid patterns, and high typography hierarchy.
Never center-align paragraph text or main layout containers globally.
Use 2-3x generous padding inside bordered containers (p-6, p-8).
Exclusively use icons from lucide-react (or radix icons), no emoji characters for UI icons.
Always test form submissions with Sonner toasts for user feedback.
Add data-testid to every interactive component.
